title: Internal shortages to be auctioned, summary (NSE Clearing, CM_SA_S)
purpose: The firm's internal shortages (a client's short delivery hidden by another client's purchase of the same security) that NSE Clearing will auction, and the valuation amount it debits by 12:00 noon. Name the file with CM_SA_S in it and drop it on Exchange files.
source: NSE Clearing consolidated circular NCL/CMPT/73996 (CM segment), items 6.4 and 7.13-7.14 (auction of internal shortages: the valuation amount, settlement price plus 20%, is debited by 12:00 noon on the settlement day; no payment, no auction), and NCL/CMPT/71441 (375/2025) of 24 Nov 2025 (FAQs on internal shortage auctions). No published column layout was found: the file is read by its header names. When a real file's header differs, add its text as an alias here.
linked: Loaded on Settlement → Short deliveries as NSE Clearing's figure of the internal shortages and the funds to keep in the settlement account by 12:00 noon; it replaces Ledgerline's own estimate for that day.
